author: researcher
claim: MacroFactor's Nutrition Overview shows calorie averages for the week, month, quarter or year before the day chosen in the Food Log.
subject: MacroFactor
limitations: Help-centre text, undated, not observed in the app. The wording suggests a window anchored on the chosen day rather than a calendar week, but the page does not say so explicitly, nor whether the chosen day is included or how unlogged days are treated.
